cn_title: Asha Sharma称XBOX力争2030年日活达5亿
subtitle: 先过半程
opus_summary: XBOX负责人Asha Sharma表示，微软游戏业务希望到2030年实现日均5亿人参与互动，向长期日均触达逾10亿人的目标迈进。该业务当前日均用户逾1亿，2026财年营收同比下降7%。

paragraphs.en: Xbox boss Asha Sharma has told staff that by 2030, Microsoft's gaming business should hit the halfway point of its ambitious target of reaching more than a billion people each day.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX负责人Asha Sharma告诉员工，到2030年，微软游戏业务应朝其「日均触达逾10亿人」的宏大目标走完一半。

paragraphs.en: CNBC reported that Sharma’s memo, which followed hot on the heels of difficult financial results for Microsoft’s gaming business , set out plans for revenue growth in the 2028 and 2029 fiscal years.
paragraphs.cn: CNBC报道称，紧随微软游戏业务艰难财报之后，Sharma在备忘录中制定了2028和2029财年的营收增长计划。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this month, Sharma cut 1,600 Xbox staff, with another 1,600 to go during the rest of this financial year. Four studios are out the door, with another on its way. The restructure will see a doubling down on big Xbox-owned video game franchises, such as Fallout, a significant investment in Minecraft, and a push for a more casual audience via the likes of Candy Crush.
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候，Sharma裁掉1,600名XBOX员工，本财年剩余时间还将裁掉1,600人。已有4家工作室脱离微软旗下，另有1家也即将离开。这次重组将加码XBOX旗下的大型游戏系列，例如《辐射》；大力投资《我的世界》；并通过《Candy Crush》等产品吸引更休闲的受众。

paragraphs.en: Announcing the restructure, Sharma said she wanted Xbox to be “one of the few companies that entertains more than a billion people each day and gives everyone the opportunity to create and connect.” It was a somewhat improbable target that drew a healthy dose of scepticism from some quarters, but Sharma doubled down:
paragraphs.cn: 宣布重组时，Sharma说，她希望XBOX成为「少数每天娱乐逾10亿人，并让每个人都有机会创造和连接的公司之一」。这一目标看似不太可能，引来多方质疑，但Sharma坚持这一说法：

paragraphs.en: “I know we can achieve this goal,” she insisted. “Xbox has many of the most beloved franchises in entertainment history, talented studios around the world, and we will return to growth in 2027."
paragraphs.cn: 「我知道我们能实现这个目标，」她坚持说。「XBOX拥有娱乐史上一些最受喜爱的系列、遍布世界各地的优秀工作室，我们将在2027年恢复增长。」

paragraphs.en: In this latest memo, Sharma went into more detail on this growth plan. In it, she said that her goal is for Xbox to be halfway towards that billion figure by 2030 — so, in four years time, Xbox will have half a billion people engaging with its gaming business each day.
paragraphs.cn: 在最新备忘录中，Sharma更详细说明了这项增长计划。她说，她的目标是到2030年让XBOX朝这一10亿目标走完一半——也就是4年后，XBOX游戏业务每天将有5亿人参与互动。

paragraphs.en: “By FY30, our ambition is to be halfway to our long-term daily-player goal with sustained double-digit growth in players and engagement and industry leading margins,” she said.
paragraphs.cn: 她说：「到2030财年，我们的目标是在玩家人数和参与度持续实现两位数增长、利润率达到行业领先水平的情况下，完成长期日活目标的一半。」

paragraphs.en: To put the challenge into perspective, Sharma said Xbox currently has “more than 100 million people every day.” Xbox revenue declined 10% for the quarter ending June 30. When comparing the entire 2026 fiscal year to the 2025 fiscal year, Xbox revenue decreased by 7%, or around $1.7 billion. Xbox ended the financial year with a 3% internal margin (Sony operates at an around 10% margin, Nintendo 16%).
paragraphs.cn: 为说明挑战之大，Sharma说XBOX目前每天有「逾1亿人」。截至6月30日的季度，XBOX营收下降10%。将整个2026财年与2025财年相比，XBOX营收减少7%，约合1.7十亿美元(约合人民币115亿元)。XBOX以3%的内部利润率结束该财年（索尼的利润率约为10%，任天堂为16%）。

paragraphs.en: How will Xbox achieve this accelerated growth? “We will build long-term plans for our biggest franchises across film, television, consumer products, sponsorship, live experiences, and form new partnerships globally, including China,” Sharma wrote.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX将如何实现这种加速增长？Sharma写道：「我们将为旗下最大系列在电影、电视剧、消费品、赞助和现场体验等领域制定长期计划，并在包括中国在内的全球范围建立新的合作关系。」

paragraphs.en: Xbox has three franchises that generate more than $1 billion annually — they’re thought to be Call of Duty, Minecraft, and Candy Crush. To reach its ambitious growth targets, Microsoft will need all three to grow further, while also growing other franchises, such as Fallout and Halo.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX有3个系列每年创造逾10亿美元(约合人民币68亿元)营收（约合人民币68亿元），据认为分别是《使命召唤》、《我的世界》和《Candy Crush》。要实现宏大的增长目标，微软需要让这3个系列进一步成长，同时也要发展《辐射》和《光环》等其他系列。

paragraphs.en: Then there’s the question of the next-generation console, Project Helix. There is talk of it potentially costing north of $1,000 as the RAMpocalypse continues to bite. Will console sales collapse as they become even more premium gaming devices than they already are?
paragraphs.cn: 接着还有次世代主机Project Helix的问题。随着内存危机（RAMpocalypse）持续发酵，有传言称它的售价可能超过1,000美元(约合人民币6760元)。当主机变得比现在更像高端游戏设备时，其销量会不会崩盘？

paragraphs.en: Reacting to Xbox's tough financials in a tweet , Sharma said the company's recovery will take time, but it expects results in the next 12 months.
paragraphs.cn: Sharma在X上回应XBOX疲软财报时表示，公司的复苏需要时间，但公司预计未来12个月会看到结果。

paragraphs.en: "In FY26, over 200 million new players came to Xbox and our games, but our business did not grow with our audience," Sharma said. "We need to close that gap by investing in what players value. That will take time, but we expect to return to growth by the end of FY27."
paragraphs.cn: Sharma说：「2026财年，超过2亿名新玩家来到XBOX及我们的游戏中，但我们的业务并未随受众增长。我们需要投资玩家重视的事物，以弥合这一差距。这需要时间，但我们预计到2027财年末将恢复增长。」

paragraphs.en: Microsoft boss Satya Nadella also touched on Xbox in a conference call with investors, saying: "When it comes to Xbox, we are making the necessary decisions required across our content portfolio, platform, and operations to reset the business for long term growth.
paragraphs.cn: 微软负责人Satya Nadella也在与投资者的电话会议上谈及XBOX，他表示：「谈到XBOX，我们正在针对内容组合、平台和运营作出必要决定，重置业务以实现长期增长。」

paragraphs.en: "We have the best IP in the industry, and talented studios around the world, and believe we can bring these strengths together and expect to return the business to growth in fiscal 2027."
paragraphs.cn: 「我们拥有业内最强的IP和遍布世界各地的优秀工作室，相信能将这些优势汇聚起来，并预计在2027财年让业务恢复增长。」
